category: local development runtime with agent sandbox VMs

free_tier.stated: No hosted allowance: Dory is a native macOS app the user installs and runs locally, free and open source under GPL-3.0, with no account, no telemetry, no required cloud and no paid tier. Docker Core is the only required download and optional signed components add Kubernetes and Linux machine or desktop VMs.
free_tier.notes: The operator list's $0.029 an hour for Dory has no basis on any first-party page: the product has no hosted meter. The hosted sandboxes of the other providers in this topic rank ahead of this download.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a local virtual machine, not a stored object; a managed .dorydrive grows from 128 GiB to 2 TiB and a machine disk is thin-provisioned at 64 GiB
per_object_cap.notes: The disk ceiling is local and set by the user.

retention.stated: Local Linux machines have their own disks and snapshots in the user's .dorydrive, preserved across normal uninstall; retention is set by the user, not by a vendor clock.

egress.terms: not applicable: the software runs on a machine the user supplies, so Dory meters no traffic and publishes no egress price or allowance

interface_detail: A versioned local JSON contract over stdio, an MCP server implementing protocol 2025-11-25, stable non-interactive CLI schemas and a Docker API context; sandbox VMs are driven by dory sandbox run, not by a public hosted endpoint.
tooling: the user installs the signed Docker Core macOS app, then optional signed components for Kubernetes, headless Linux and desktop VMs; the user runs the app on their own Apple Silicon Mac and uses the dory CLI or MCP server, with no vendor-run capacity.
chaining: A policy-enforced Linux VM per agent run with read-only mounts, allowlisted egress, resource caps, rollback and TTL cleanup can replace a hosted sandbox only where the user already has an Apple Silicon Mac; a hosted sandbox record ranks ahead of it.

limits.value: the user installs and runs the app on an Apple Silicon Mac; there is no hosted capacity to allocate, and Windows 11 ARM and Intel hosts are unavailable

limits_note: Apple Silicon only; desktop images are limited to Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Kali rolling. USB passthrough and Intel host releases are unavailable, and custom ARM64 guest images are preview. The agent sandbox is policy-enforced with allowlisted egress and a daemon TTL.
binding_note: The offer is software the user installs on their own Mac, so there is no hosted quota, rate or retention clock to bind; the requirement to install it is the gate.

identity_cost.detail: No account is required: the site states 'No account. No telemetry. No required cloud. GPL-3.0.' and '0 accounts, telemetry, paid tiers'. Signing in is not an option because there is no vendor-hosted service. The user supplies their own Apple Silicon Mac and local disk.

reliability_note: Capability support is labelled supported, preview or unavailable; the agent sandbox and custom guest images are preview, USB passthrough and Intel hosts unavailable, and signed updates keep a last-good snapshot for automatic rollback. No hosted service reliability event exists.
confidence_note: The no-hosted-capacity finding, GPL-3.0 licence, no-account statement, component model and local sandbox description are read from the vendor's site and a third-party directory page on 2026-11-25 and quoted below.
